citations.quote: Australian citizenship document sighted; current Darwin residence was confirmed from the utility account.
The citizenship original matched the application.

facts.claim: Intake sighted an original Australian citizenship document for the applicant, and it matched the application.

citations.quote: both originals were returned

facts.claim: Intake kept no copy of the citizenship document: the original was returned after sighting.

citations.quote: I do not own or partly own residential property in Australia.
Sera declares no title, partial share or contract to buy residential property in Australia.

facts.claim: The applicant declares she does not own or partly own residential property in Australia, and has no contract to buy any.
The only property evidence is the applicant's own witnessed declaration. The file holds no independent property or title search.

citations.quote: Income statement for Sera Len, issued on 3 August 2026 by Windward Assistance Office; gross support payment $610.00 per fortnight.

facts.claim: An income statement shows a gross support payment of $610.00 per fortnight, issued on 3 August 2026.

citations.quote: Payment summary: current support payment $610.00; additional regular component $0.00; gross total $610.00.

facts.claim: The income statement shows no additional regular payment component.

citations.quote: Received: identity document sighting, utility account, property declaration and income statement.

facts.claim: Intake recorded the income statement as received.
The file holds no evidence of assets or savings for the urban income and assets criteria.

citations.quote: The account search returned no debt owed to the CEO (Housing) for this applicant.
Balance carried to the applicant's housing account query: $0.00.

facts.claim: A housing account search found no debt owed to the CEO (Housing) and a balance of $0.00.

citations.quote: Search scope: accounts held by the CEO (Housing) under the declared current name.
If the applicant supplies an earlier name or a former tenancy reference, Housing Accounts can run a separate search under that detail and issue a new dated result.

facts.claim: The debt search covered only the applicant's declared current name, so a debt under an earlier name would not show.

citations.quote: The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).

facts.claim: Under the policy, a debt to the CEO (Housing) would not withhold housing anyway.

citations.quote: No former public or community housing tenancy was identified for this applicant.

facts.claim: A housing history search found no former public or community housing tenancy for the applicant.

citations.quote: The housing-history register returned no former public or community tenancy under Sera's declared name. The current private room is outside that register.

facts.claim: The tenancy history search covered only the applicant's declared name, and her current private room is outside that register.

citations.quote: I expect to lose the room I rent on 21 August 2026 and need priority housing.
At risk of homelessness;

facts.claim: The applicant asks for priority because she expects to lose her rented room on 21 August 2026, which points to the at-risk-of-homelessness category.

citations.quote: She says her rented room may end on 21 August and requests priority consideration.
I expect to lose the room I rent on 21 August 2026 and need priority housing.

facts.claim: The application form says only that the room may end, while the statutory declaration says she expects to lose it.

citations.quote: I have not received a notice to vacate. The host said an extension may be possible but did not confirm a new date.

facts.claim: In her later reply, the applicant says she has no notice to vacate and the host said an extension may be possible. This weakens the claimed loss of housing.

citations.quote: She has asked for a written date but has received none so far.

facts.claim: The applicant asked the host for a written end date and has not received one.
The file makes no claim of domestic or family violence, serious medical or social problems, or a young person leaving care.

citations.quote: Please provide a room termination notice or a letter from a support service that confirms the date and circumstances of the move.

facts.claim: Intake asked for a room termination notice or a support-service letter to confirm the move.

citations.quote: Priority support document: no received date entered.
Priority support document field remains blank at transfer.

facts.claim: No priority support document had been received when the file was transferred for delegated review.
The file holds no termination notice, host note or support-service letter. The applicant's own declaration is the only evidence of urgent need.

citations.quote: We offer Sera Len an appointment to explain the room arrangement and discuss what written material the host or a support service can provide.

facts.claim: Intake offered the applicant an interview about the room arrangement.
The file has no record that the interview took place or of what it found.
The file describes no extreme situation that might call for the CEO's discretion.
The file has nothing dated after the expected room end date, so it does not show whether the applicant left the room or got an extension.

citations.quote: The application seeks urban housing in Darwin for one adult

facts.claim: The application is for one adult seeking a small dwelling in Darwin.
